device.description: 16-bit 100 kSPS true-differential SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface and daisy-chain
device.note: ads8867.pdf (SBAS615A) p.9 pin assignments, p.4 power-supply requirements, p.5 timing requirements (3-wire), p.5 timing diagram, p.19 transfer function (twos complement), p.19-20 3-wire CS mode

pages: p.9 (pins), p.4 (supply ranges), p.5 (3-wire timing) p.19 (transfer function), p.19-20 (CS modes), p.23 (daisy-chain)
notModeled: analog input and reference (true-differential input; the 0 V code is 0000h, twos complement)
mode selection by the DIN level at the CONVST rising edge: only 3-wire CS mode without a busy indicator (DIN high, CONVST as CS) is modeled; DIN is not read
4-wire CS mode (DIN as CS) and daisy-chain mode (DIN as chain input)
DOUT driven while CONVST is low during a conversion (modeled: the frame shows the last result)
conversion time varies 500-8800 ns (modeled: tconv-max 8800 ns); acquisition time and power-down between conversions
variants: ADS886x/ADS888x family (datasheet p.1 family table): 18-bit true-differential ADS8881 (1 MSPS) / ADS8883 (680 kSPS) / ADS8885 (400 kSPS) / ADS8887 (100 kSPS); 16-bit single-ended ADS8860 / ADS8862 / ADS8864 / ADS8866; 16-bit true-differential ADS8861 / ADS8863 / ADS8865 / ADS8867. Same 10-pin pinout and interface; each has its own datasheet and spec.
